title: Student Profile
description: The harness's persistent memory of one student. Updated after every session (Hard Rule). Lives at students/<id>/profile.json.

id.description: Anonymous ID; never store real names here (keep any name only in students/<id>/private-notes.md, gitignored).

grade.description: Nominal school grade. Actual level comes from mastery, not this.

interests.description: Used for problem contexts and hooks: cricket, drawing, space, Minecraft... Refresh every few sessions; each entry may carry specifics, e.g. 'cricket (bats left-handed, follows RCB)'.

language.description: How this student prefers to be TALKED to. Notation stays standard; explanations flex.

explanation.description: Preferred language/register for explanations, e.g. 'english', 'hinglish', 'hindi', 'tamil-english mix'. Honor it in every session.

notes.description: e.g. 'switches to Hindi when a concept is hard - follow her there, return to English for the summary'.

motivation.description: What actually drives this student. Chosen rewards/celebrations must match drivers (rules/40). Never peer comparison.

drivers.description: Ranked, strongest first. From the intake interview + observed reactions.

personal_records.description: e.g. 'first 3/3 topic test (2026-07-02, mult-tables)'. Reference these; beating your own record is the only competition allowed.

celebrations_that_landed.description: Observed: what genuinely delighted them vs. what fell flat.

retention.description: Personal forgetting curve, per strand. Multiplier scales the review ladder in rules/10 (1.0 = standard). Tuned by /reflect from lapse data: strand lapse rate < 10% over >= 5 reviews -> nudge up (max 1.5); > 30% -> nudge down (min 0.6). Move in 0.1 steps, never on fewer than 5 observations.

error_signature.description: Cross-topic error habits - about the STUDENT, not any one node. Mined by /reflect (all) from question history. Coach the habit explicitly; a repaired habit pays off everywhere.

pattern.description: e.g. 'drops negative signs when working fast', 'reads OF as addition in word problems', 'answers before reading the full question'.

coaching.description: The move that helps, e.g. 'ritual: circle every minus sign before starting'.

conceptual_ok.description: At least one conceptual/application item answered correctly (required for true mastery).

id.description: Misconception id within that node, e.g. m2.

retest_after.description: When the next repair-confirmation retest is due (rules/40: +2d, then +7d).

strategy_stats.description: Keyed by strategy name (modality or thinking routine, optionally scoped ':strand', e.g. 'visual:num', 'socratic', 'see-think-wonder').

worked.description: Sessions where the follow-up check succeeded after this strategy.

attention_span_min.description: Observed productive minutes before a break is needed.

frustration_signals.description: Observed tells: short answers, 'whatever', asks to switch topic...

reengagement_moves.description: What has actually re-engaged this student.

own_metaphors.description: The student's own working metaphors — reuse them when teaching.
